name: Re;world episode1
source:
Human fate is controlled by the god Jupiter.
A young man named Mikage Wada is suddenly freed from the fate decided for him.
Faded love, false friendship... and deceit.

He was killed by an angel and saved by another, Venus.
Together with her, he seizes fate like no human has done, intending to wrest it from god.

"What can a powerless human do?" 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE100860.html]DSite English[/url]]
